title: What the Rain Keeps
poem: i.  Somewhere a door I did not close is still open. I feel its draft in my hands.
ii.  Each morning I assemble the same face and hope it holds till dark.
iii.  I remember a room I have never stood in. The light there is always late.
iv.  I keep an inventory of tendernesses meant for someone else.
v.  A photograph insists: this happened, this was warm.
colophon: drift and pull; a field that never settles the same way twice.
